name: Ember Lynx
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SINGLE FRONT VIEW reference for image-to-3D character generation for our Fortnite-inspired game. Create one full-body character, facing directly toward camera, symmetrical relaxed A-pose, arms 35 degrees away from torso, hands open and empty with five distinct fingers, feet shoulder-width apart, complete head and boots visible with margin. Orthographic-looking front view. Solid clean medium-light grey background, soft even studio lighting, minimal ground shadow. High-quality stylized 3D videogame art, expressive strong readable silhouette, vibrant colors, semi-realistic clean PBR materials, Fortnite art direction. Original character design. No text, logos, watermarks, weapons, tools, handheld props, attached weapons, backpacks, companions, base pedestal, scenery or multiple views. Subject: original friendly athletic muscular anthropomorphic lynx hero, inspired by Fortnite's playful feline mascot characters. Upright bipedal anatomy with human-like hands and feet proportions, amber orange short fur, cream muzzle and brow patches, dark pointed ear tufts, green expressive eyes, short feline snout. Wearing a sleeveless deep teal utility vest over a charcoal shirt, orange cargo trousers with charcoal knee pads, chunky grey tactical boots and teal fingerless gloves. Broad shoulders and modest heroic muscular torso. Tail absent from frontal silhouette, no large or thin projecting accessories. Clearly adult mascot, clean appealing sculpted stylized fur, no individual realistic hair strands.
